name: Drag Drop Machine
description: Interactive drag and drop demo where a file tile is dragged onto a folder target, with a live state badge, hover glow, drop confirmation and automatic reset.
contents: Draggable file tile with gradient and icon
Folder drop target that opens and glows when hovered while dragging
Machine state badge, captions and instruction hint
behavior: Mouse down on the file starts a drag and the tile follows the cursor with a tilt
Entering the folder while dragging highlights it and changes captions
Releasing over the folder shows a done state, then resets after resetDuration
Releasing elsewhere snaps the tile back
Mouse events only, no touch dragging

props.name: hintText
props.default: Drag the element to safely process the operation

editableByProps: All captions, hints and state label text
Tile gradients as Tailwind gradient classes and background color

needsCodeEdit.where: svg elements inside the file tile and folder target

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the folder glow and border colors
needsCodeEdit.where: isInside class branch on the folder target div

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Window mousemove and mouseup listeners are used for dragging and removed on unmount; touch dragging is not supported
Text and badge colors use fixed stone tones suited to a dark background
